buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Near KV School Lakhanpur Kathua (J&K) . 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.

4. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 6. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 2 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Dedicated / toll free telephone no. for service support: bidder/ OEM must have dedicated / toll free tele phone no. for service support. 2. Escalation Matrix for Service Support: Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 3. ISO 27001 required for the project. 4. In the event of the Seller’s failure to deliver the good/ services by the date specified in the contract, the Buyer may deduct from the Seller as liquidated damages the sum of 0.5% of the contract price of the undel ivered goods/ services for delay of each week or part of week and the Seller shall submit the documents af ter deduction of the liquidated damages subject to a maximum of 10% of the contract price of the undelivered goods/ services. 5. Compliance Matrix is attached with bid duly filled by bidders. 6. The service provider/bidder should have registered under Companies act 1956/2003 or any other as per Gol acts. Copy of certificate of registration to be attached. 7. The service provider shall deliver all components, software, licenses, and services as per approved Scop e of Work, specifications, and timelines. 8. All work shall be executed on a turnkey basis including installation, configuration, integration, testing, commissioning, documentation, and training. 9. Development, deployment, and integration activities shall be carried out at Buyer premises and in air-g apped/on-premise environment as applicable. 10. All data processed, stored, or transmitted shall be encrypted at rest and in transit using industry-stand ard security mechanisms. 11. The seller shall implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), audit logging, PII protection and security hardening across the solution. 12. The complete system shall undergo Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) before Go- Live and all critical vulnerabilities shall be rectified before acceptance. 13. All software, source code, configurations, datasets, reports, and related deliverables developed under the project shall remain the intellectual property of the Indian Navy. 14. The seller shall not reuse, disclose, or repurpose project deliverables, source code or datasets without written approval from the Buyer. 15. The seller shall ensure that the deployed solution is free from bugs, malware, malicious code, or unaut horised third-party copyrighted material. 16. The seller shall provide complete technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, SOPs, user manuals, and administration manuals in soft and h ard copy formats. 17. The seller shall provide training and knowledge transfer sessions to the Buyer’s nominated technical an d operational teams. 18. Delivery, installation, testing, and commissioning shall be completed within the agreed project timeline s defined in the Delivery Schedule. 19. The bidder shall comply with all applicable Government of India regulations, security policies, and data

privacy requirements. 20. A minimum warranty and support period of 12 months shall be provided post Go-Live, including bug fix ing, patches, updates, and issue resolution at no additional cost. 21. Liquidated damages for delay shall be applicable as per contract terms in case of non-compliance with delivery timelines. 22. Buyer reserves the right to conduct Pre-Contract Negotiation (PNC), technical discussions, and clarifica tion meetings before award of contract. 23. One instance of the application shall be deployed in Buyer’s air-gapped network environment for secur e operational usage. 24. The seller shall maintain confidentiality of all project information, datasets, configurations, credentials, and operational details shared during execution. 25. The vendor shall maintain confidentiality of all project information, datasets, configurations, credential s, and operational details shared during execution. . 8.
